zh: 聊天记录改为独立会话，可新建、查看并切换历史会话
新增放大聊天布局，显示桌宠、历史会话和当前消息；回答支持选中和复制
设置中可刷新并选择服务商提供的模型，聊天中可调整支持模型的推理强度
保存设置后提供成功或失败反馈
增加应用退出和前端异常诊断日志，并降低鼠标/窗口状态轮询频率
应用内更新检查现直接读取 GitHub 最新正式 Release 并打开对应安装包下载
en: Chat history is organized into separate conversations that can be created, browsed, and selected
Expanded chat shows the pet, conversation history, and current messages; answers can be selected and copied
Refresh and choose provider models in settings, with reasoning-effort controls for supported models
Settings now report whether saving succeeded or failed
Added app-exit and frontend-error diagnostics, and reduced pointer/window polling frequency
In-app update checks now read the latest stable GitHub Release and open its installer download
